themeSettings.announcement: Flat £4.99 UK delivery on every order
themeSettings.tagline: Hand-picked toys, beds, walking gear and grooming for dogs and cats.

features.title: Flat £4.99 UK Delivery
features.text: £4.99 per order within the UK, shown at checkout before you pay.

promises.title: Helpful Hands
promises.text: Our team is here at every step, from choosing the right product to after-care support.

promises.title: "Do You Ship To"
promises.text: Probably! Our products are made and dispatched worldwide.

promises.title: Love At First Sight
promises.text: Every product is hand-picked and checked against real supplier data before we list it.

faq.a: Most orders arrive within 2-7 days. Items are dispatched from our partner warehouses, and busy periods or customs checks can add a few days.

faq.q: Do you deliver across the UK?
faq.a: Yes, we deliver pet products across the UK. Delivery options, charges and estimated times are shown clearly at checkout.
UK delivery is a flat £4.99 per order.

faq.q: Where are the products shipped from?
faq.a: We work with several warehouses, so products ship from different locations depending on what you order.

faq.q: How do I buy from your website?
faq.a: Choose your product, add it to your basket and check out securely. We accept Apple Pay, Google Pay and all major debit and credit cards.
